meta.title: Neon Orbits
meta.fusion_note: Progressive house supplies groove and form; authored retro palette supplies timbre. No synthwave-specific MC skill exists, so the Serum analog guide owns its architecture.

upstream.brief: buatkan musik retro synthwave edm, dengan beat 4 on the floor beat dan menggunakan polyrithm dan polymeter ala deadmau5, dengan mode minor harmonic, gunakan semua skill yang terkait dengan ini, terutama /skill:mc dan skill di dalam repo

intent.one_thing: Membuat perjalanan malam yang terus bergerak melalui pergeseran siklus synth di atas kick yang stabil.

reference_pair.track: User's deadmau5 direction (conceptual reference, no recording supplied)
reference_pair.borrow: Slow additive/subtractive development and interlocking synth sequences; no named melody or transcription.

reference_pair.track: User's retro synthwave direction (palette reference, no recording supplied)
reference_pair.borrow: Maintained subtractive monosynth bass, DCO-like chorus pad, rounded poly brass.

intent.listener_situation: Extended instrumental for headphones and a melodic dance-floor set; eight/sixteen-bar structural anchors.

emotional_arc.mood: Filtered pulse, kick enters bar 9; pad opens the space.
Shorten the motif; remove bass for bars 45-48 and stop the final beat.
Lead states the full hook; 3:2 pulse enters bar 57; brass answers in gaps.
No drums or bass; glass keys stretch the hook over a new harmonic route.
Rebuild the seventh-note tension; kick returns at bar 105.
Dynamic recap: motif returns, higher late answer, more open filter, thinner pad under lead.
Subtract lead, brass, triplet pulse, then arp and hats; retain a mixable four-floor exit.
Final Em at bar 161, then three bars with no new attacks for release.

material.motif: E turun kuart ke B lalu naik kuint ke F# dan semiton ke G; onset 0, .75, 1.5, 2.25 beat selama satu bar, diikuti jawaban turun pada bar berikutnya. Signature C-D#-E dipakai untuk tarikan harmonic minor.

bass_kick_relation.detail: Kick is on integer beats; bass attacks .5,1.5,2.5,3.5 with short gates. Kick remains the 4/4 anchor.

spectrum_budget.resolution: Bass attacks offbeats and decays before the next kick.
Brass answers phrase gaps, pad drops alternating two-bar cells; arp velocity recedes under lead.
Separate sections; keys carry the beatless breakdown.

subtraction_events.why: Expose a slower harmonic reading of the motif

arrangement_hook.what: Seven-eighth-note 2+2+3 accents rotate over four quarter-note kicks; lead adds an E-B-F#-G contour.

push_pull.note: Repo strict timing takes precedence; variation uses velocity, gates, polymeter and polyrhythm.

fill_policy.rationale: Uneven phrase punctuation; no automatic fill every fourth bar.

mix_intent.mood: Hangat dan gelap, dengan kick jelas serta urutan synth yang terus bergeser.

notes: No measured DR target for unrendered MIDI. Breakdown should be audibly below drops; verify after sample choice.

mix_intent.loudness_target: No mastered-audio target: MIDI and preset delivery.

self_audit: Intent complete; references are conceptual and not claimed as analyzed recordings.
Sections contiguous; 4-bar coda earns its length by tonic release.
Energy falls at breakdown and outro; roster changes and early exits are explicit.
Harmony uses the requested seven-note collection only; leading-tone harmony is intentional.
Fill bars are not a four-bar arithmetic sequence; width is designed per patch and section density, not a claimed DAW automation.
Every section develops the same motif; no uncontrolled new section material.
MIDI backend preserves notes/timing/controllers exactly; sound and mix need actual instruments.
exemptions: #9: Do not add scale-external harmony or modulation merely to satisfy an MC heuristic; user requests harmonic minor.
#11: All onsets remain quantized, because AGENTS.md requires strict/no-swing timing; velocity and gates supply expression.
#13: Suno prompt is irrelevant; selected backend is deterministic MIDI.
#15/#16 and vocal audit items: instrumental piece.
ARR-SPEC mode enum lacks harmonic minor; mode=minor with exact pitch collection in composition.json and request.md.
Reference-pair recordings and listening A/B were not supplied/performed; two user concepts used instead.
